author_activity.assessment: LIKELY FALSE POSITIVE, not genuine author-driven removal. check-wayback.js reported this per PROP-128 protocol (previously archived:true, now archived:false), which the protocol treats as HIGH-signal. Independent verification this run: (1) re-ran the script a second time, same result; (2) called the exact API request the script makes (encodeURIComponent'd URL) directly via curl and node -- consistently returns empty archived_snapshots for the encoded form; (3) called the identical endpoint with the URL unencoded in the query string -- consistently returns a valid closest snapshot at the same timestamp (20260709182001); (4) cross-checked against the independent CDX Server API -- confirms 3 snapshots exist for this exact URL, all statuscode 200, most recent 20260709182001. The snapshot is demonstrably still live; this is a URL-encoding-sensitive quirk in the Wayback Availability API for this specific request shape, not evidence the dome author requested a Wayback takedown. Full verification detail and a suggested script fix are in monitor/social/drafts/check-wayback-encoding-quirk-2026-07-14.md, routed to decider/tinker since check-wayback.js is git-owned source code. Logged per protocol (removal_alerts must be surfaced) but should NOT be read as a genuine author-activity signal.
